title: SDOH-CKDPred: open CKD small-area surveillance and screening-triage pipeline
description: Analysis code for the JMIR Public Health and Surveillance submission (ms 101575). Stage 1 relates the Neighborhood Atlas Area Deprivation Index to CDC PLACES 2022 tract-level diagnosed CKD prevalence; Stage 2 identifies adults with single-visit laboratory markers of CKD in NHANES 2017-2023 without laboratory inputs, using a survey-weighted logistic regression (primary) and XGBoost (comparator). All results are regenerated from public data by the scripts in src/. The Neighborhood Atlas ADI file is not included (data use agreement).
